_meta.description: Carrier loss-run routing table. Maps a carrier group to the sub-companies that write under it, and each sub-company to the mailbox or portal that services loss-run requests. Copy to loss_run_carriers.json — the real file is gitignored because it holds several hundred named carrier claims contacts.
_meta.group_company: The canonical carrier group. The extraction engine resolves whatever appears on a binder to one of these.
_meta.sub_companies: Paper-writing entities that roll up to the group. A binder naming any of these resolves to the group.
_meta.coverage: Which line this contact services, or 'All'.
_meta.primary_email: Where the request goes. Empty when the carrier is portal-only.
_meta.portal_link: Carrier portal, when one exists. The Loss Run skill surfaces this instead of drafting an email.

contacts.secondary_email: Check online first; email only if unavailable
